case3.conclusion: Control kept polling during this lease. New-frame processing record is later than old lease expiration; the trace does not retain this packet HTTP-arrival/enqueue timestamp, so waiting for new data and waiting to process already queued data cannot be separated for this specific packet.

internal_queue_evidence.scope: At least one already HTTP-decoded packet waited inside the follower process during this same trial; the maximum is not linked to a particular lease event.

transport_scope.HTTP: Only FaceStream worker consumes existing localhost NDJSON; main drain uses get_nowait.
transport_scope.hardware_IO: Pinned BatchRegisters/NativeRegisters use ctypes C functions against existing exclusive device handle, not an interprocess hardware command service. Public inspected native C includes platform property-file checks as well as fenced MMIO; wall-time cost per operation is not logged.

audio_ABA_evidence_limit: Same-page ON/OFF/ON correlates with slower preview and HTTP and reduced face-ready observations under recording, without LLM/speaker jobs. The follower was stopped during this ABA, so GUI/camera main-thread rq-wait values do not directly profile the running follower thread.
minimal_evidenced_focus: Input delivery/processing budget must fit the actual returned59..128ms leases, not merely a raw camera header<250ms.
Remove identified unnecessary continuous-audio/shared scheduling work before changing the accepted motion path; CPU thread profile is needed to name the exact hotspot.

Synchronous report preparation is a measured21.584ms control-thread cost and a candidate for budget-aware scheduling, but no event timestamp proves it caused case3; do not claim this as an already verified fix.
